response.overview: The Minoan House is a film about an an human adventure and an archeological experimentation. Maia Pomadère, from the French School of Athens, and Sorbonne, brought together a team of specialists to carry out this experiment, not far from the Palace of Malia in Crete, using materials from the Minoan era: timber, mud bricks, ancient tools... Each specialist helped to demonstrate that a new approach to construction could be envisaged, drawing on the past.
response.title: Malia, the Minoan House
